title: paper-lantern onprem weekly sync — prep & action log
content:
Meeting: Paper-Lantern customer — weekly engineering + ops sync (internal prep)
Planned meeting date: 2026-03-12 (Wed) 10:00 PT — 30m sync
Attendees (expected): Asha (CS), Miguel (SRE), Tom (Customer infra lead), Rylie (Redwood eng), Hannah (solutions)

Purpose / quick goal: get alignment on next-week milestones for on-prem rollout v0.9, unblock image-pull throttling, confirm cert rotation window, and assign owners for remaining infra tickets. Keep meeting lightweight — focus on blockers and owners.

Agenda (tight, 30m):
- 2m quick status (Rylie) — green/amber/red summary
- 6m infra blockers deep-dive (image pulls, NFS mounts)
- 6m networking & certs (LoadBalancer / edge-proxy rotation plan)
- 6m deploy schedule + housekeeping window for DB migration (customer requested)
- 6m action item review + owners + deadlines
- (if time) 4m runbook handoff notes

Notes to self / prep points to raise:
- Image pull throttling: customer reported >40% failed pulls on initial parallel node builds. Hypothesis: OCI registry rate limits + registry auth misconfig on nodes. Ask Miguel for recent pull-rate graphs (last 48h). Bring JIRA-PL-3124 details.
- NFS mount flakiness: intermittent timeouts during parallel training loads. Need exact kernel + mount options from customer (Tom) and we should propose switching to noatime/vers=4.2 as temporary. Add to runbook.
- Cert rotation: proposed window Fri 03/19 02:00–04:00 PT. Confirm outage expectations (customer wants <5m disruption). Prepare fallback (keep old certs valid + traffic drain).
- DB migration (housekeeping): customer requested rolling migration with zero-downtime if possible. We can do blue/green but need confirmation of replica lag tolerance. Put migration plan in shared Confluence link pre-read.
- Observability gaps: token-level request IDs not propagated through the edge-proxy -> add ticket JIRA-PL-3170. Need to confirm tracing headers with customer.
- Disk pressure: node kubelet eviction threshold lower than expected; recommend adjusting ephemeral-storage requests for model cache pods.

Stability status (my quick call):
- Build & deploy: amber — image pulls (blocking 2 nodes), otherwise OK
- Runtime: amber — intermittent NFS timeouts under load test
- Network/certs: green -> but rotation needs scheduling + rollback plan

Open questions for Tom (customer):
- Are you okay with Friday 03/19 cert window? If not, propose Mon 03/22 01:00–03:00 PT.
- Can you share exact mount options + kernel version for affected nodes? (we need /proc/mounts + uname -a)
- Replica lag tolerance for DB migration (ms or seconds acceptable?)

Action items (to review at end of meeting) — initial owners + tentative due dates:
- A1: Miguel — collect OCI registry pull metrics and share screenshots + rate limit logs (due: 2026-03-13 EOD)
- A2: Rylie — draft fallback cert rotation runbook (include rollback command set + traffic-drain steps) (due: 2026-03-16)
- A3: Tom (customer) — provide exact mount options and kernel info + confirm permissive time window for maintenance (due: 2026-03-13)
- A4: Hannah — open JIRA ticket to propagate request-id header through edge-proxy with proposed header key X-Request-ID and sample trace map (due: 2026-03-14)
- A5: Asha & Solutions — validate DB migration plan with customer PM and confirm acceptable replica lag (due: 2026-03-15)
- A6: Rylie & Miguel — prepare short demo of parallel node build with throttling simulation (for next sync) (due: 2026-03-18)

Notes / possible risks:
- If registry rate limits are a hard cap, we should propose using a local pull-through cache in the customer's VPC; estimate: 2–4 hours to stand up and test. Have rough cost estimate ready.
- NFS timeouts under load could cause eviction/Pod restarts which would look like model failures; add readiness probe tuning as mitigation.
- Cert rotation outage tolerance may be overstated; we need to clarify what “<5m” means for their SPA frontends vs long-running gRPC streams.

Pre-reads to attach in calendar invite:
- Confluence: Paper-Lantern OnPrem runbook (link above)
- JIRA-PL-3124 (image pull logs)
- Short troubleshooting checklist I want to walk during the call (pasted below)

Troubleshooting checklist (quick):
1) Check registry auth token expiry on node: cat /etc/redwood/registry-token.json (ask Tom to run)
2) Pull sample image with max retries: crictl pull --retries=5 <image> and capture stderr
3) Check dmesg for NFS I/O timeouts and mount stat: grep -i nfs /var/log/messages || journalctl -k | grep nfs
4) Trace request-id propagation: curl -H 'X-Request-ID: test-123' https://edge-proxy-host/health and watch logs on model pods

Meeting follow-up template (I will paste into meeting notes after sync):
- Summary: one-liner status
- Decisions made: bullet list
- Blockers: bullet list (owners)
- Actions assigned: table-like bullets (owner — action — due)
- Next sync agenda items

Random notes-to-self (scratch):
- Consider adding a tiny helper script to collect /proc/mounts + uname + crictl images to reduce back-and-forth with customer. Ship as gist and ask Tom to run.
- Check if we can surface registry rate limit headers from their OCI provider — if so we can set adaptive backoff in image fetcher.

Draft meeting opener (two lines):
"Quick status: overall progress steady, two infra items (image-pull and NFS) are impacting full-parallel deploys. Main goal today: pick owners, confirm cert window, and agree next steps for image-pull mitigation."

End of prep notes. I will paste this into calendar invite description and attach runbook + JIRA links prior to sync.

-- Rylie
